title: Misclassified leave understated San Francisco’s foster-care reimbursement by $6,777

beats.text: In 2015 San Francisco payroll records supported a foster-care claim that was too low.

visual.sub: Leave hours went to the wrong activity categories

beats.text: The problem was how probation staff recorded sick leave and vacation time.

visual.line: The problem was how probation staff recorded sick leave and vacation time.

beats.text: Different program activities qualified for different federal reimbursement rates.

visual.kicker: Leave hours went to the wrong activity categories

beats.text: Auditors tested two of the four quarterly time studies.

visual.kicker: Two quarterly studies understated reimbursement by $6,777

beats.text: The City understated federal reimbursement by $6,777 in those studies.
The auditors projected an understatement above the $10,000 reporting threshold.

visual.kicker: Two quarterly studies understated reimbursement by $6,777

beats.text: They did not publish a full-year dollar estimate.

visual.kicker: Two quarterly studies understated reimbursement by $6,777

beats.text: Probation met with supervisors and introduced a check on time allocations.
It also planned to compare those records with payroll timesheets.
The fiscal 2016 audit marked the action implemented.
It did not document payment of the original $6,777.
An amended claim and state remittance would answer that question.
Every source is linked in the case file below.
